capabilities.label: Sign in
capabilities.description: Identify your account using OpenID Connect.

capabilities.label: Basic profile
capabilities.description: View your public profile information.

capabilities.label: Email address
capabilities.description: View your account email address.

capabilities.label: Stay connected
capabilities.description: Renew access until you revoke the application or the authorization expires.

capabilities.label: Read account
capabilities.description: View your account, settings, available models, and group availability.

capabilities.label: Edit account
capabilities.description: Change your display name and personal settings.

capabilities.label: Read API keys
capabilities.description: View your API key settings without exposing complete keys.

capabilities.label: Manage API keys
capabilities.description: Create and manage credentials bound to this application authorization.

capabilities.label: Reveal API keys
capabilities.description: Reveal complete API keys after confirmation on this site.

capabilities.label: Read usage
capabilities.description: View your usage logs, statistics, and task history.

capabilities.label: Read wallet
capabilities.description: View balance, top-ups, subscriptions, and referral information.

capabilities.label: Manage wallet
capabilities.description: Start payments, buy subscriptions, redeem credit, check in, and transfer referral rewards.

capabilities.label: Read account security
capabilities.description: View sign-in methods, two-factor status, and sessions.

capabilities.label: Manage account security
capabilities.description: Change password, sign-in bindings, two-factor settings, sessions, or delete your account after confirmation on this site.

capabilities.label: Read authorizations
capabilities.description: View applications authorized by your account after confirmation on this site.

capabilities.label: Manage authorizations
capabilities.description: Reduce or revoke application authorizations after confirmation on this site.

capabilities.label: Read model access
capabilities.description: Read available models and the usage of this application's relay credentials.

capabilities.label: Call models
capabilities.description: Send model requests, create generation tasks, and use streaming or realtime responses with your account balance.

capabilities.label: Read model tasks
capabilities.description: Read and manage generation tasks owned by your account.

capabilities.label: Read users
capabilities.description: View users and their account information with your existing administrator permissions.

capabilities.label: Manage users
capabilities.description: Create, modify, disable, or delete users and reset their security settings within your existing permissions.

capabilities.label: Read finances
capabilities.description: View financial reports, top-up records, subscription plans, and user subscriptions.

capabilities.label: Manage finances
capabilities.description: Manage financial entries, complete top-up orders, and administer subscriptions.

capabilities.label: Read model settings
capabilities.description: View model and vendor configuration and upstream synchronization previews.

capabilities.label: Manage model settings
capabilities.description: Edit models and vendors and synchronize upstream model configuration.

capabilities.label: Read deployments
capabilities.description: View deployments, logs, infrastructure, and price estimates.

capabilities.label: Manage deployments
capabilities.description: Create, modify, extend, or delete deployments and test connections.

capabilities.label: Read all usage
capabilities.description: View account-wide usage logs, statistics, and tasks with administrator permissions.

capabilities.label: Read redemption codes
capabilities.description: View redemption code configuration.

capabilities.label: Manage redemption codes
capabilities.description: Create, edit, and delete redemption codes.

capabilities.label: Read group settings
capabilities.description: View groups and prefill group configuration.

capabilities.label: Manage group settings
capabilities.description: Create, edit, and delete prefill groups.

capabilities.label: Read application center
capabilities.description: View managed applications, releases, announcements, and telemetry.

capabilities.label: Manage application center
capabilities.description: Manage applications, releases, uploaded assets, announcements, and telemetry.

capabilities.label: Reveal application secrets
capabilities.description: Reveal or rotate telemetry credentials after confirmation on this site.

capabilities.label: Read channels
capabilities.description: View channel lists and details without secrets.

capabilities.label: Operate channels
capabilities.description: Test channels, refresh balances, and enable or disable channels.

capabilities.label: Edit channel routing
capabilities.description: Edit channel models, groups, and routing rules with your existing channel permissions.

capabilities.label: Edit sensitive channel settings
capabilities.description: Create channels or edit upstream keys, base URLs, and overrides with your existing channel permissions.

capabilities.label: View channel secrets
capabilities.description: View complete channel keys after confirmation on this site.

capabilities.label: Read system settings
capabilities.description: View system settings, identity providers, and price synchronization sources.

capabilities.label: Manage system settings
capabilities.description: Change system settings, identity providers, and price synchronization configuration.

capabilities.label: Read OAuth applications
capabilities.description: View registered OAuth client configuration.

capabilities.label: Manage OAuth applications
capabilities.description: Create, modify, disable, or delete OAuth clients after confirmation on this site.

capabilities.label: Read operations
capabilities.description: View service performance, logs, system tasks, and instances.

capabilities.label: Manage operations
capabilities.description: Run maintenance tasks, clear caches, and manage service operation settings.
